title: Telling the Dead from the Slow — The Foot of Mount Phyle
description: Chandra and Toueg's unreliable failure detectors: four mercenaries and their ravens, a slate at each tent that may be wrong, and how little it needs to get right.
question: A machine that has crashed looks exactly like one that is merely slow, and that alone makes agreement impossible. How well must we tell the dead from the slow before agreement becomes possible again?
how: We find out by exploring how the same Greek mercenaries, each keeping a slate of the tents he thought dead, agreed whether to attack or hold though the slates were often wrong.

papers.authors: Tushar Deepak Chandra and Sam Toueg
papers.title: Unreliable Failure Detectors for Reliable Distributed Systems
